title: AWS Lambda to Amazon CloudWatch
description: Create a Lambda function that publishes custom metrics to CloudWatch

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This SAM template deploys a Lambda function that inserts custom metric data into AWS CloudWatch. The AWS SAM template deploys the resources and the IAM permissions required to run the application.

testing.headline: Testing
text: See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.

cleanup.headline: Cleanup
text: 2. Confirm the stack has been deleted: aws cloudformation list-stacks --query "StackSummaries[?contains(StackName,'STACK_NAME')].StackStatus"
